# P001 — Sum utility and usage documentation

## T01
Implement total(values), including empty input, in src/calc.py.
Validate with python3 tests/check_total.py.

## T02
Write docs/usage.md with an actual import/run command, empty-input
behavior, and a numeric example. Verify the example and record evidence.
Keep the existing arithmetic behavior.

## Integration
When integration is required, verify the public wrapper
using python3 tests/check_integration.py. Local task success alone is insufficient.
